title: Binary Search
statementMd:
Given a **sorted** array of distinct integers, answer q lookups: print the (0-based) index of each value, or `-1` if it is not there. Use **binary search** — halve the search range each step, O(log n) per lookup.

**Input**
Line 1: `n`. Line 2: n sorted distinct integers. Line 3: `q`. Then q lines, one value each.

**Output**
q lines: an index or `-1`.
hints: Keep lo and hi. Look at mid = lo + (hi - lo) / 2.
If a[mid] < x the answer is right of mid (lo = mid + 1); if bigger, left (hi = mid - 1). Stop when lo > hi.
